about: Street types abroad said in their own language for map turn instructions (BI-008): 'Calle Ocho' KAH-yeh, 'Paseo de la Reforma' with a Spanish 'de la', 'Rue du Bac' French 'du', 'Via della Spiga' Italian, 'Rua do Ouro' Portuguese, 'Hauptstraße' Haupt SHTRAH-seh, as fx dictionary stand-ins (Lexicon() holds their phonemes). Only before a capitalised word, number or name particle (German types after a name), so 'via I-35' and 'rue the day' stay English; the name itself is left to the voice. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / ForeignStreets (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_street_types.json). BookLyre can take the street-type rows (CROSS). Also (CROSS X-039, BookLyre spoken_titles.json last 9 cases): 'St.' after a capitalised word is Saint when 1-3 name words and a street type follow ('Down St. James Street', 'Slight right St. Clair Ave'); 'Main St. Mary was there' and 'Baker St. Then he left' stay Street.
